prompt: Our approval packet tool runs a pre-flight check before a packet goes out for sign-off, and it is blocking packets it should not. A coordinator attached a 30 KB site survey with the per-file cap set to 32 KB, and the pre-flight flagged it as over the cap. The bug is in `oversizedAttachments` in `src/attachments.mjs`. Fix it so the pre-flight stops flagging attachments that are under the cap. The regression command is `npm test`.
